note: Seychelles: every visitor, whatever the nationality, must obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation through the Seychelles Electronic Border System before departure (EUR 10 standard), and is then issued a free Visitor's Permit on arrival for 90 days (extendable, not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Seychelles Electronic Border System's own FAQ: no traveller needs a visa, and every one needs an approved Electronic Travel Authorisation before arrival (a EUR 30 penalty at the airport without one); the 90 days stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Seychelles
sources.said: All visitors to Seychelles are required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation before departure. ... Citizens of all countries must obtain a free Visitor’s Permit on arrival after obtaining an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) through the Seychelles Electronic Border System prior to departure. The permitted stay for all nationals is 90 days.

sources.title: Seychelles Electronic Border System, FAQs: Information for Visitors & Tourists
sources.said: Do I need a visa before travelling to Seychelles? There are no visa requirements for any traveller visiting Seychelles. Travellers must complete their Travel Authorisation or Disembarkation Information Form (citizens only) prior to travel to Seychelles. This can be submitted up to 30 days before travel ... All travelers are required to have an approved Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA) before they can be processed by Seychelles Immigration on arrival. You will be charged a penalty fee of 30EUR at the airport, if you arrive without a pre-approved eTA.
